description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'HolidayDaoTest' that tests various functionalities of the 'HolidayDao' data access object related to holiday management in the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup procedures, individual test cases for methods like getHolidayById, saveHoliday, searchHolidays, getHolidayByDate, and deleteHolidays, verifying the correct behavior and data management of holiday entities.

classes.name: HolidayDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test suite for testing the HolidayDao data access object, focusing on CRUD operations and search functionalities for holiday entities in the OrangeHRM application.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating an instance of HolidayDao and populating test data from a configuration fixture.

methods.name: testGetHolidayById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a Holiday entity by its ID, verifying instance type and field values.

methods.name: testSaveHoliday
methods.description: Tests saving a Holiday object with modifications, ensuring persisted data matches input.

methods.name: testSaveHolidayWithNoId
methods.description: Tests creation of a new Holiday entity without an ID, verifying it is assigned after saving.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysWithoutFromToDates
methods.description: Tests searching for holidays without date filters, expecting recurring holidays.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysWithoutFromToDatesAndExcludeRecurring
methods.description: Tests search with exclude recurring flag set, expecting zero results.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysWithoutFromDateAndExcludeRecurring
methods.description: Tests search filtering with only toDate set and exclude recurring, expecting zero results.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysWithoutToDateAndExcludeRecurring
methods.description: Tests search filtering with only fromDate set and exclude recurring, expecting zero results.

methods.name: testSearchHolidaysExcludeRecurring
methods.description: Tests complex date range filtering with exclude recurring flag, verifying correct holidays are returned.

methods.name: testSearchHolidays
methods.description: General search test with specific fromDate and toDate, verifying multiple holidays are returned in expected order.

methods.name: testGetHolidayByDate
methods.description: Tests retrieving a holiday by specific date, asserting correct holiday name is returned.

methods.name: testDeleteHolidays
methods.description: Tests deleting holidays by IDs, verifying the number of deleted entries.
